covenants.name: Total Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: shall not exceed 3.50 to 1.00 (for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, the Company’s Total Leverage Ratio was 2.00 to 1.00)

covenants.name: Senior Secured Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00 for any fiscal quarter ending on or after September 30, 2024 (for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, the Company’s Senior Secured Leverage Ratio was 1.99 to 1.00)

covenants.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
covenants.quote: shall not be less than 3.00 to 1.00 (for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, the Company’s Interest Coverage Ratio was 5.23 to 1.00)

covenants.name: Total Net Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: The limitations described above are not currently applicable, as the Company’s Senior Secured Leverage Ratio was 1.99 to 1.00 and the Total Net Leverage Ratio was 2.14 to 1.00, as of June 30, 2026.
